transparent.business_two_sentences: Axsome Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing novel therapies for central nervous system disorders, including major depressive disorder, migraine, narcolepsy and Alzheimer's disease agitation. It has no FDA-approved products and funds operations from cash reserves and equity financing while its lead drug, AXS-05, awaits an anticipated NDA filing [c6].

sources.title: Axsome Therapeutics Announces AXS-05 Achieves Primary Endpoint in GEMINI Phase 3 Trial in Major Depressive Disorder (Exhibit 99.1 to Form 8-K)

excerpts.text: AXS-05 met the primary endpoint by demonstrating a highly statistically significant reduction in the...MADRS total score compared to placebo at Week 6, with mean reductions from baseline of 16.6 points for AXS-05 and 11.9 points for placebo (p=0.002).

The GEMINI study was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center, U.S. trial, in which 327 adult patients with confirmed moderate to severe MDD were randomized to treatment with either AXS-05...or placebo
Response, defined as a ≥50% improvement in the MADRS total score, was seen at Week 6 in 54.0% of patients who received AXS-05, compared to 34.0% of patients who received placebo (p<0.001).
AXS-05 demonstrated a statistically significant mean reduction from baseline in the MADRS total score of 7.3 points for AXS-05 compared to 4.9 points for placebo at Week 1 (p=0.007)

The most commonly reported adverse events in the AXS-05 arm were dizziness, nausea, headache, diarrhea, somnolence, and dry mouth. There was one serious adverse event in the AXS-05 arm which was deemed by the investigator not to be study-drug related.
Axsome plans to file the NDA in the second half of 2020...AXS-05 was granted Breakthrough Therapy designation by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the treatment of MDD in March 2019.
AXS-05 is also being evaluated in the STRIDE-1 Phase 3 trial in patients with treatment resistant depression (TRD)...and in the ADVANCE-1 trial in patients with Alzheimer's disease agitation.
FDA's agreement with the Company's plan to discontinue the bupropion treatment arm of the ADVANCE-1 study in accordance with the independent data monitoring committee's recommendations

claims.text: AXS-05 (dextromethorphan-bupropion) met the primary endpoint in the pivotal Phase 3 GEMINI trial, reducing MADRS depression-severity scores by 16.6 points versus 11.9 points for placebo at Week 6 (p=0.002).

GEMINI was a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicenter U.S. trial of 327 adults with confirmed moderate-to-severe major depressive disorder, randomized 1:1 to AXS-05 (n=163) or placebo (n=164) for 6 weeks.

All secondary endpoints were statistically significant at Week 6, including remission (39.5% vs 17.3%, p<0.001), response (54.0% vs 34.0%, p<0.001), disease severity (p=0.002), functional impairment (p=0.002) and quality of life (p=0.011).
AXS-05 showed statistically significant improvement over placebo as early as Week 1 (MADRS reduction of 7.3 vs 4.9 points, p=0.007), the earliest timepoint assessed.

The most common adverse events were dizziness, nausea, headache, diarrhea, somnolence and dry mouth; one serious adverse event occurred in the AXS-05 arm and was deemed unrelated to study drug; discontinuation due to adverse events was 6.2% (AXS-05) vs 0.6% (placebo); no psychotomimetic effects or weight gain were reported.

Axsome said GEMINI, together with the previously completed ASCEND trial, is sufficient to support an NDA filing for AXS-05 in MDD, anticipated in the second half of 2020; AXS-05 received FDA Breakthrough Therapy designation for MDD in March 2019.
AXS-05 is also in the STRIDE-1 Phase 3 trial for treatment-resistant depression and the ADVANCE-1 Phase 2/3 trial for Alzheimer's disease agitation, with Fast Track designations for both indications.

As of the November 7, 2019 update: STRIDE-1 was concluding patient screening with topline results expected Q1 2020; ADVANCE-1 was about 70% enrolled with topline expected in the first half of 2020; the AXS-07 migraine trial MOMENTUM had completed enrollment with topline expected Q4 2019 and a second AXS-07 trial, INTERCEPT, started in October 2019 with topline expected Q1 2020; the AXS-12 narcolepsy trial CONCERT had completed enrollment with topline expected Q4 2019.

Axsome reported $43.6 million of cash at September 30, 2019, down from $53.8 million at June 30, 2019, and said it believes this cash will fund operations, under its current operating plan, into the second quarter of 2021, with no new equity financing anticipated before its Phase 3 readouts.

Per the Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2019: cash and cash equivalents were $43,641,861 (vs $13,968,742 at December 31, 2018); total assets $44,439,729 (vs $15,379,279); common stock shares outstanding 34,496,846 (vs 30,087,213); the company stated existing cash should fund operations for at least twelve months from the filing date.
Net cash (cash and cash equivalents less total long-term debt, current and noncurrent) was approximately $23.9 million at September 30, 2019, versus approximately $7.1 million at December 31, 2018.

claims.text: Standalone third-quarter 2019 net cash used in operating activities was approximately $10.6 million, versus approximately $5.9 million in the third quarter of 2018.
claims.formula: Nine-month year-to-date operating cash flow minus six-month year-to-date operating cash flow, from the same fiscal year's 10-Qs

claims.text: At the trailing nine-month 2019 average quarterly operating cash-outflow rate (about $9.6 million/quarter), the $43.6 million cash balance at September 30, 2019 implies roughly 4.5 quarters (about 13-14 months) of funding on hand from that date -- a simple scenario calculation, not a company forecast.

Per the same December 16, 2019 filing's risk disclosures, Axsome had proposed to discontinue the bupropion-monotherapy treatment arm of the ADVANCE-1 study on the recommendation of an independent data monitoring committee, with the FDA's agreement to that change not yet confirmed as of the filing.
